title: Use IgnitionLaneActivityModel data in “MDI Support chat for Haslet” to troubleshoot lane/package activity
summary: Use the Ignition-based “MDI Support chat for Haslet” screen to gather evidence from the lane activity table that references [dbo].[IgnitionLaneActivityModel]. Focus on which lane/package records are present and what the table shows for Message, PackageClassification, and MissingDimensionData (plus sorter-side and sort status fields such as SorterSide* and NewSort/SortConf/SortCont) to support troubleshooting.
when_to_use: When you need troubleshooting evidence about lane/package activity visible in the “MDI Support chat for Haslet” screen, specifically the lane activity table content backed by [dbo].[IgnitionLaneActivityModel].
not_for: Do not use this as a complete runbook to resolve the underlying issue end-to-end; the source frames this screen as troubleshooting/evidence gathering rather than a full resolution procedure.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the “MDI Support chat for Haslet” screen and extract observable evidence from the lane activity table fields (including Message, PackageClassification, MissingDimensionData, and sorter-side/sort status fields) for the suspected lane/package records.

access_required: Access to the “MDI Support chat for Haslet” screen
